integrity_policy: Published corpus versions are immutable. New failure classes are appended in a new corpus version; existing cases and expected classifications are not rewritten to improve detector performance.
data_policy: Synthetic-only. No real institutional, patient, participant, or health-service data may be committed to this challenge corpus.
